title: Framework’s better couch keyboard is now available for preorder
description: Framework announced its Wireless Touchpad Keyboard earlier this year with the goal of delivering a better couch keyboarding experience than the Logitech K400. According to The Verge's Sean Hollister who went hands-on with Framework's new all-in-one keyboard and touchpad last April, the company has succeeded in that goal, but it turns out you'll be paying […]
